name: Athena Parthenos
text: The statue of Athena Parthenos (Ancient Greek: Παρθένος Ἀθηνᾶ, lit. 'Athena the Virgin') was a monumental chryselephantine sculpture of the goddess Athena. Attributed to Phidias and dated to the mid-fifth century BCE, it was an offering from the city of Athens to Athena, its tutelary deity.

depictions.name: Athena Parthenos
depictions.text: Athena Parthenos was a massive chryselephantine sculpture of the Greek goddess Athena, housed in the Parthenon in Athens, Greece. It was considered one of the greatest achievements of the sculptor, Phidias. During the Peloponnesian War, the statue was visited by the Spartan misthios Kassandra.
